name: Build a walkable surface grid from the collision world
body: Engine (Nox, `engine/src/navigation/`). Sample the static collision world on a regular grid with down rays to find every standable surface (floor span with headroom for the agent, slope below the controller's limit). Cells are nodes. Moving bodies are not in the grid (see the follow-up card). Decision: a sampled grid rather than a triangle navmesh, because the level is built from boxes and ramps, a grid handles stacked floors with spans, and the prototype needs predictable behaviour more than minimal node counts.
